guitar.notes: Virtual/collaborative project with rotating session musicians; no single guitarist identity.

tone.target: dark, gritty funk-rock bass riff tone with tight low end
tone.profile: dark, gritty funk-rock bass riff tone with tight low end
tone.summary: A tight signal chain using compression and mild fuzz into a powerful British amp model (UK 45) with a scooped cabinet, emphasizing rhythmic attack and dark grit.

rig.name: Gorillaz - Feel Good Inc. - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Cleaning up the low-end rumble and maintaining tightness for the bass riff.
Providing compressed punch and consistent attack required for a tight bass riff.
Adding the required fuzzy edge and grit without excessive high-end bloom.
blocks.gap: The RAT is often used for mid-range bite, which suits the 'mid-scooped' requirement. A dedicated fuzz might be too thick.

blocks.purpose: Creating the required mid-scooped bite and emphasizing low-end punch.
Providing a punchy, British rhythm tone suitable for aggressive funk-rock.
blocks.gap: The UK 45 is excellent for tight rhythms, mimicking the necessary aggression and definition.

blocks.purpose: Providing a focused, punchy cabinet sound that complements the tight low end.
blocks.gap: The UK Basket 4x12 is known for its solid mid-range and definition, which helps keep the bass riff clear and non-muddy.

blocks.purpose: No modulation or chorus needed; keeping the tone dry and focused on rhythm.
blocks.gap: The instructions explicitly avoid wah and chorus.

blocks.purpose: Keeping the delay completely bypassed to maintain a dry, tight, and aggressive sound.
blocks.gap: The instructions explicitly avoid long delay.

blocks.purpose: Adding minimal room ambience to give the riff some space without losing its punch or dryness.
blocks.gap: Used sparingly (low mix) to avoid sounding washed out, maintaining focus on the rhythm.

improvements.summary: Enhance cabinet realism for better definition and tightness in the bass role.

proposals.recommendedAsset: song-appropriate IR (e.g., Ampeg 4x10 or dedicated Bass Cab)
proposals.reason: The current cabinet is general; a specialized bass cab will improve low-end definition and tightness.
proposals.expectedGain: Improved clarity and punch in the low end.
